gloss: to hang out; to form a group; to pal around

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: つるんでいませんでした

definitions.gloss: to hang out; to form a group; to pal around
definitions.explanation: To spend time together in a group, often with slightly negative connotations suggesting idleness or questionable company.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧⟦{連中|れんちゅう}→連中：14372_renchuu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧つるんで⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: He's always hanging out with the same crowd.

examples.japanese: ⟦{不良|ふりょう}→不良：11320_furyou⟧⟦グループ→グループ：03840_guruupu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧つるむな。
examples.english: Don't hang out with that delinquent group.

examples.japanese: {学生時代|がくせいじだい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧つるんで⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Back in my student days, I hung out with friends every day.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY:
Intransitive verb (⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧). No pair verb.

USAGE:
つるむ often carries a slightly negative or neutral-casual nuance, suggesting people spending time together without much purpose. It can imply questionable company or idle hanging around, though it can also be used neutrally among friends.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜⟦と→と：00512_to⟧つるむ (to hang out with ~)
- つるんで⟦{遊|あそ}ぶ→遊ぶ：00550_asobu⟧ (to play around together)
- ⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧つるんで⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ (always hanging out together)

REGISTER:
Casual/colloquial. Not used in formal contexts.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{一緒|いっしょ}→一緒：02848_issho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ - to be together (neutral)
- ⟦{付|つ}き{合|あ}う→付き合う：02291_tsukiau⟧ - to associate with/date (broader meaning)
- つきあう - same as above (hiragana)
- ⟦{群|む}れる→群れる：18481_mureru⟧ - to flock together (can be negative)
